system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep "Serial Number"

wmic bios get serialnumber

*Mac*:
1. Launch *Outlook* on your Mac.
2. From the top menu, *select Tools*.
3. Click *Automatic Replies*.
4. Enable *Send automatic replies for this account.*
5. (Optional) Select *Only send replies during this time period* and set dates.
6. Enter your out-of-office message.
7. Click *OK* to save and activate your settings.

*Windows*:
1. Open *Outlook* on your Windows device.
2. Click on *File* in the top-left corner.
3. Select *Automatic Replies* (Out of Office).
4. Choose *Send automatic replies.*
5. (Optional) Check *Only send during this time range* and set dates.
6. Enter your message for internal and external users.
7. Click *OK* to save and enable your settings.
Outlook will now send automatic replies based on your settings.
